title: Budget of the United States Government, Fiscal Year 2026 collection
notes: Official Government Publishing Office collection for the President's Fiscal Year 2026 budget submission. Admissible to establish proposed executive-branch budget levels, priorities, and supporting documents. It is not evidence of enacted appropriations, obligations, expenditures, final outlays, or realized savings, and must not be compared directly with actual-year Treasury data without labeling the accounting stage.
